envelope.author: GuardPromptPlanner
envelope.reason: the omp guard module judges a context that does not say which session it is against the persona's contract, and wraps every payload in a transcript label; enforcement scope now says a guard judges the performing agent's contract and hands its judge only the test, the act and the contract
envelope.cause: note "kino's supply is halted by the purview guard"; shard enforcement scope, amended 2026-09-30T21:21, handed down by the architect

spec.name: omp-guard-precise
spec.intent:
Census @cbac6a5f (plan/purview-routes: closed, unreleased as PR #42, and it changes this unit's files over main 15d0a621); re-derive any line cited below if its path changed since.
BASE. This unit's branch must hold cbac6a5f before any change: unless `git merge-base --is-ancestor cbac6a5f HEAD` succeeds, merge plan/purview-routes into it first, so the work stands on that line's omp message mapping and the plan line meets no conflict when PR #42 lands.
Realize on omp two clauses of `enforcement scope` as amended 2026-09-30T21:21: a guard judges an act against the contract of the agent that performs it, and where a harness cannot tell which agent is running the guard is not enforced and the operator is told; and what a guard hands its judge is only its test (the rubric) and the act and contract it applies to (the worker's payload).
AT CENSUS. The persona guard module is generated by packages/forge/src/adapters/omp/render.ts. A judging registration returns before its worker runs when `inSubagent(ctx)` (L670), and `inSubagent` (L793-794) reads `ctx.agent !== undefined && ctx.agent.kind !== "main"`, so a context carrying no `agent` is judged against the persona's contract whichever session it came from. In the installed omp 18.4.5 (~/.local/bin/omp) the extension runner is built with `kind: nn ? "sub" : "main"`, where `nn = (e.taskDepth ?? 0) > 0 || Boolean(e.parentTaskPrefix)`, and a spawned subagent loads its parent's extension paths [read from the binary; not yet observed in a live session]. Kino's session whose subagents were judged by kino's contract (SupplyK2g, 2026-09-30T14:08Z) was started at 07:53 local, before 0.7.3, which added the skip, was installed at 08:53 [inferred from process and file times]. askJudge (L1011-1109) sends the judge the payload wrapped as `=== BEGIN TRANSCRIPT EXCERPT (operator instruction + agent turn) === … Apply the rubric. Output ONLY the verdict block.` (L1063), which labels a purview payload (a contract and an act) as a transcript. The comments at L633-639 and L1150 rest on the stance worker's no-progress detector and on a re-entry cap, both removed by units stance-guard-precise, pre-call-refusal-holds and purview-guard-precise.
CHANGE. A judging registration runs its worker only when `ctx.agent?.kind === "main"`. A subagent session is judged by nothing and says nothing, as now. A context with no `agent` is judged by nothing, and the module relays, by the path it relays a worker's let-through notice (L1111 on), one line naming the guard and saying it could not tell which session is running, so the call was not judged. askJudge sends the worker's payload alone as the user message, with no label and no instruction line; the rubric carries the output format. Reword the comments at L633-639 and L1150 so that none rests on a no-progress detector or a re-entry cap. In packages/forge/test/adapters/omp.test.ts, contexts that stand for a main session carry `agent: {kind: "main", …}`, and the stub worker mode `noprogress` (L619, L771), a notice no worker prints once this plan lands, is removed. Keep JUDGE_TIMEOUT_MS, JUDGE_MISS_LIMIT, JUDGE_COOLDOWN_MS, the act bindings and the message mapping unchanged. Add .changeset/omp-guard-precise.md (@cratylus/forge patch).
accept: SESSION: a case in packages/forge/test/adapters/omp.test.ts loads the module ompGuardrailExtensions generates for a persona binding tool.use.pre, on a worker stub that counts its fires, and fires one tool_call with `ctx.agent` `{kind: "main", id: "0-main", depth: 0}`, one with `{kind: "sub", id: "0-Child", parentId: "0-main", depth: 1}` and one with no `agent`: the worker is fired once, zero times and zero times, and the third relays a line naming the guard and saying it could not tell which session is running. Against render.ts at cbac6a5f the third fires the worker, so the case fails there.

PAYLOAD ALONE: a case with a completeSimple stub that records its request finds the user message content equal, byte for byte, to the payload the worker emitted under STANCE_EMIT_PAYLOAD. At cbac6a5f it is wrapped in the transcript-excerpt label, so the case fails there.

LIVE on the installed omp (print `omp --version`; 18.4.5 at census): `omp -p --no-extensions -e <the module generated for a test persona, placed in a temp scope, whose worker command is a stub that appends the tool name of every fire to a file and allows>` with a prompt that has the main agent dispatch one `task` subagent that writes a file under a temp dir. The stub's file records the main session's `task` call and nothing from the subagent, while the subagent's file exists; print the stub's file and the written path. A model that cannot be reached prints `could not look: <why>` and the criterion is not met.
`grep -n -E 'no-progress|re-entry' packages/forge/src/adapters/omp/render.ts` prints nothing; at cbac6a5f it prints L638 and L1150.
Green: `pnpm --filter @cratylus/forge exec vitest run test/adapters/omp.test.ts` and `pnpm --filter @cratylus/forge typecheck` exit 0.
`git diff --name-only <the unit's base holding cbac6a5f> <landed commit>` lists only paths in this unit's outputs (records/ excepted).
